51710.author: battibass
51710.body:
This PR removes discrepancies that were observed when producing low-pT electrons NANOAOD branches using the following workflows:

- **Mini v2/v4** -> **NANO v15**
- **Mini v2/v4** -> **Mini v6** -> **NANO v15**

with the second one implying persisting **Mini v6** data produced from earlier Mini versions.

Results from the comparisons ran for different Run 2 and Run 3 years are available [at this page](https://battilan.web.cern.ch/battilan/crossPOG/MINI2MINI/2026_sep_03_ppd_talk/).
In particular, the present fix improves agreement in all Run 2 (data and MC) workflows, Run 3 ones are not affected.

Overall, the status of workflows persisting **Mini v6** were [presented at PPD General on September 3rd](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1711141/#2-xpog-review-of-miniaod-conte).

51984.author: vince502
51984.body:
#### PR description

 This PR enables single-leg conversion recovery in Run 3 PbPb events with configurable HF tower sum threshold. It keeps the recovery disabled above the proposed threshold  (5300 GeV) and adjusts the conversion seeding and
 track-building settings for PbPb.

Tested with 10k 2025 data, the impact on timing is around 3% increase w.r.t. baseline, memory increase not seen, and edmEventSize shows the miniAOD increased by 0.44% from the increased number of conversion candidates. Performance
 results are in the slides (https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1fzZ5sLEpsCBc4Lwnf1KxEU9RLMv37LvENaWI4WcZksk/edit?usp=sharing).
 
 The default behavior would not alter the reconstruction settings, as the max hf threshold should be set explicitly.

 #### PR validation

 Tested with MC workflow 160.03 and data workflow 141.301. Both passed. For 141.301, I replaced the input with a 2023 PbPb RAW data file.

 #### Backport

 No backport planned.
51984.title: Adding HF filtered conversion single leg recovery for Run 3 PbPb

52149.author: davidwalter2
52149.body:
#### PR description:

Fixes #52148. The SiStripCluster read rules for class versions 10-11 and 12-13, added in #47094, are never executed when the clusters are read member-wise from split sub-branches.
- Every SiStripCluster collection written by CMSSW <= 14_X at split level 99 is therefore read as empty clusters, without any error: no amplitudes, firstStrip 0, barycenter 0, charge 0.
- This covers AOD/RECO, ALCARECO, the muon reduced-track-extras clusters and 2024 PromptReco MINIAOD.

The cause is a ROOT bug, root-project/root#23686:
- ROOT gives a rule's function to the element of its first target and inserts it after the last source.
- With several same-named sources, and the first target not being the last source, the rule function ends up on no branch.

This PR reorders the targets so that the first target is the last source: `firstStrip_` for v10-v11, `charge_` for v12-v13. The sources and the rule code are unchanged, and a comment records the constraint. The change works with every ROOT version and stays correct once ROOT is fixed. master and 20_X are not affected, because #50968 removed the read rules.

#### PR validation:

The comparison used a per-event digest of every SiStripCluster collection: detId, firstStrip, amplitudes, barycenter and charge of each cluster. Split-level-99 files were compared with split-level-1 copies of the same events. The checks ran in CMSSW_15_0_19_patch2, 15_1_2 (ROOT 6.32.13), 16_0_10, 16_1_3 and 17_0_0_pre2 (ROOT 6.36):

| input (writer, split 99) | current rules | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| UL17 AOD (10_6) | 751/751 clusters empty | identical to split 1, 40/40 events |
| UL16 MINIAOD (10_6) | 1679/1679 and 1777/1777 empty | identical, 100/100 and 100/100 |
| 2016 TkAlJpsiMuMu ALCARECO (10_6, central) | 5814/5814 empty | 5814 filled |
| 2022D MINIAODv4 (13_0) | 4078/4078 empty | identical, 200/200 |
| 2024F AOD (14_0) | 1593/1593 empty | identical, 60/60 |
| 2024F TkAlZMuMu ALCARECO (14_0) | 2928/2928 empty | identical, 100/100 |

The results are the same in all five releases. Split-level-1 input reads unchanged. The reproducer in #52148 gives 0 empty clusters with this PR, against all clusters empty without it.

Backports: #52150 (16_1_X), #52151 (16_0_X), #52152 (15_1_X) and #52153 (15_0_X). Every release that reads Run 2 or 2022-2024 AOD, ALCARECO or split-99 MINIAOD is affected, including any re-MINI of 2024 AOD.

52184.author: DanielEstrada971102
52184.body:
backport of https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/50896

This PR implements SL2 support, enriches shower metadata, and refactors the buffer model to align with firmware-like behavior.

### Key Changes
*   **Support SL2:** Integrate Super Layer 2 shower primitives.
*   **Fix Buffer Logic:** Identify hits by both wire and layer in `buffer_contains` to prevent data loss.
*   **Improve Timing:** Assign shower BX based on the first received hit.
*   **Refactor Buffering:** Overhaul buffer handling and candidate containers to capture missing early hits.
*   **Enhance Metadata:** Track wire, layer, and TDC for all digis used in shower construction.
*   **Future-Proof Containers:** Use vectors for shower candidates to support future multi-candidate output.

### Other changes
*   **ROOT Output:** Enable saving shower-associated hits in ROOT format for offline debugging.
*   **Logging:** Add a stream-like helper for standardized log messaging.
*   **Orbit Support:** Extend `DTPrimitive` with orbit-correction capabilities.

### Impact
* The resulting logic more closely emulates expected firmware behavior.
* These updates increase the shower production / rate.

More details in this [presentation](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1695073/contributions/7127869/attachments/3288534/5879344/presentacion-cmsl1trigger-meeting-040626.pdf)
